run_maniptrans_eval: run the maniptrans evaluation script to compute tracking metrics et, er, ej, eft from rollout NPZ files
run_multiseed_eval: run multi-seed evaluation scanning all data_id directories and report mean plus std across seeds
evaluate_trajectory_npz: evaluate a single rollout NPZ file and compute object translation, rotation, joint, and fingertip error metrics
discover_trajectories: discover all left and right hand trajectories under a base directory with auto-detection of SPIDER and RL files
compare_spider_vs_rl: compare SPIDER MPC results against RL baseline with per-trajectory delta and aggregate improvement statistics
